originalTitle: Google’s upcoming Pixel phones are for the fans, even if its launch event isn’t
summary: Last year's Made by Google event for the Pixel 10 resembled a late night talk show, complete with Jimmy Fallon as host, and it aired an hour after the phones were revealed. content: Last year’s Made by Google event for the Pixel 10 resembled a late night talk show, complete with Jimmy Fallon as host, and it aired an hour after the phones were revealed. Spec dives and executive appearances were replaced with celebrity cameos and awkward skits, to the confusion of many diehard Pixel fans. But it served its purpose in reaching a broader audience: Last year’s stream racked up 8.4 million viewers on YouTube; the launch the year before only managed 1.4 million. This year, Google has only escalated matters. For tomorrow evening’s livestream, Fallon has been replaced by Trevor Noah, who will lead a “stacked” lineup of celebrities including basketball star Stephen Curry, podcaster Alex Cooper, and DJ Peggy Gou. What the event won’t have is many surprises. While the launch event kicks off at 6PM ET, the Google Store’s preorder countdown is set to end eight hours earlier, presumably when the phones will be revealed in full. [Media: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WJ4HciY60i4] By the time Google’s stream starts, its most avid fans will know exactly what’s coming. Then again, for the most part, they already do. In a world where almost every spec leaks ahead of time, it makes sense that Google’s celeb-centric launch event won’t be targeted at Pixel power users.  Google’s been one of the most adaptive companies when it comes to the modern proliferation of phone leaks. Last year it took the unusual step of simply revealing the Pixel 10 design in full almost a month ahead of the launch. This year it’s only showed glimpses of the Pixel 11 series, but in the process has revealed something that should excite most power users more than the launch itself: a notification light. [Video: Google Pixel 11 glowing orb teaser] The light is built into the camera island of the Pixel 11 Pro (though perhaps not the regular model), where the flash normally is, suggesting that it serves as the flash and flashlight too. It’s a small feature, but a surprisingly big part of Google’s smartphone heritage. The majority of Google’s Nexus phones included hardware notification LEDs, and Google was one of the last manufacturers to drop the feature, which saw a brief resurgence in 2017’s Pixel 2 before Google binned it off again — we thought for good. The RGB lights could be used to show the phone’s charging status, flash when notifications come in, and activate in different colors. Open-source Android skins like CyanogenMod and apps like Light Flow gave even more flexibility, letting users set specific colors and blink rates for specific apps or contacts.  Notification LEDs went out of fashion about the same time that the always-on display came in. Who needs a little light when you can have the actual notifications on the screen at all times? Some Android phones instead include the option to have the edges of the display flash a certain color when notifications come in, which can even be visible when the phone is face down, depending on the design, but dedicated lights have been few and far between. [Image: Nothing’s Phone 2 made a statement out of its Glyph Lights. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/24785447/DSC05077_processed.JPG?quality=90&strip=all] The most prominent recent examples have all come from Nothing, which has elevated the LED into an art form. Ever since 2022’s Nothing Phone 1, it’s incorporated complex light arrays and dot-matrix displays into the back of its phones, allowing not just quick flashes but complex, customizable patterns or icons that can vary by contact or app. There’s only one other recent phone I can think of to feature a dedicated LED, though in the case of the Trump phone, it felt like proof of its dated, recycled design rather than a forward-thinking feature. The small light shown in the camera bar of the 11 Pro is more subtle than most of Nothing’s designs, though seemingly more colorful. Google hasn’t said what the light can do, though since the pulsing, multicolored animation resembles some of the Gemini design language, it seems a smart guess that it relates to Google’s AI assistant. Leaks suggest it may light up when you talk to the chatbot or receive calls from certain contacts, though I hope Google has more in mind for it than that, with the same customizability by app and by contact that Nothing phones support. The cruelest trick of all would be to bring back the notification light and then not have it light up for notifications. Perhaps it’s odd that on the eve of Google’s flagship phone launch I’m most excited about the apparent resurrection of a feature Google sent to the graveyard nine years ago. I presume the new Pixel phones will also be interesting in other ways, with the usual chipset bumps, camera upgrades, and design language tweaks.  But as the company pushes into entirely new ways of launching its phones to entirely new audiences, there’s a charm in it giving its oldest fans what they want when it comes to the hardware itself. Somehow I doubt it’s going to dig any further and reveal a Pixel 11 with a 3.5mm headphone jack, microSD card slot, or replaceable battery, but at least we can dream.
chineseTitle: 谷歌即将推出的 Pixel 手机是为粉丝准备的，即使它的发布会不是
chineseSummary: 去年 Pixel 10 的 Made by Google 活动就像一场深夜脱口秀节目，由吉米·法伦 (Jimmy Fallon) 担任主持人，在手机发布一小时后播出。规格潜水和高管露面被名人客串和尴尬的短剧所取代，这让许多顽固的 Pixel 粉丝感到困惑。但它[…]
chineseContent: 去年 Pixel 10 的 Made by Google 活动就像一场深夜脱口秀节目，由吉米·法伦 (Jimmy Fallon) 担任主持人，在手机发布一小时后播出。规格潜水和高管露面被名人客串和尴尬的短剧所取代，这让许多顽固的 Pixel 粉丝感到困惑。但它达到了吸引更广泛观众的目的：去年的直播在 YouTube 上吸引了 840 万观众；前一年的发布仅获得了 140 万。今年，谷歌只是将问题升级。在明天晚上的直播中，特雷弗·诺亚 (Trevor Noah) 取代了法伦，他将领导一个“堆叠”的名人阵容，其中包括篮球明星斯蒂芬·库里、播客亚历克斯·库珀和​​ DJ 佩吉·郭。活动不会有很多惊喜。虽然发布会于美国东部时间下午 6 点开始，但 Google 商店的预订倒计时将提前 8 小时结束，大概届时这些手机将全面亮相。 [媒体：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WJ4HciY60i4] 当 Google 的直播开始时，最狂热的粉丝就会确切地知道即将发生什么。话又说回来，在大多数情况下，他们已经这样做了。在几乎所有规格都提前泄露的世界里，谷歌以名人为中心的发布会不会针对 Pixel 高级用户是有道理的。  就现代手机泄密事件的泛滥而言，谷歌一直是最具适应性的公司之一。去年，它采取了不同寻常的举措，在发布前近一个月简单地公开了 Pixel 10 的完整设计。今年，它只展示了 Pixel 11 系列的一瞥，但在此过程中，我们发现了一些比发布本身更让大多数高级用户兴奋的东西：通知灯。 [视频：Google Pixel 11 发光球体预告片] 灯内置于相机岛中
